combination.declaration: 1..4 splits, each as in p2-concept-split; no duplicate split; at most 10 symbols in the union
combination.axioms: the axioms of every split (subsumption, coverage, exclusivity) fixed by p2-concept-split-draft-1; the request cannot add or change an axiom
combination.old_symbols: symbols that are not a part of any split
combination.new_symbols: symbols that are a part of some split
combination.components: splits connected by a shared symbol; axioms and adopted literals factor over components
combination.structure: single, disjoint, forest, shared_parts or cyclic, recomputed from the declared splits; chain when a parent is a part of another split
combination.structure_source: never taken from a request field, an individual certificate or a self-claim

semantics.conservativity: a component is conservative over its old symbols iff every valuation of the old symbols extends to an assignment that satisfies the component axioms; decided by exhaustive enumeration, valid because the axioms are monadic and the old symbols carry no axiom
semantics.counterexample: the first unextendable old valuation in symbol-name order
semantics.certificate: certified only for a conservative combination; not_certified carries the counterexample; an individual certificate is never the basis
semantics.joint_status: projection of the models of the component that agree with the adopted literals onto each split, read with the p2-concept-split status table
semantics.individual_status: the p2-concept-split result for the same split from its own axioms and the adopted literals over its own symbols
semantics.differs: joint and individual status or candidates differ
semantics.factoring: a split alone in its component has the same joint and individual result
semantics.interaction_violation: a component has no model although no split in it is inconsistent alone
semantics.no_conversion: no rule maps a joint status to a base status; converted_to_base is always false
semantics.unknown_capability: any visible assertion in the context requiring a capability other than the P0 profile, the split profile and this profile blocks the row, including pending and corrected assertions
semantics.conflict: any adopted positive and negative pair of the same atom in the context blocks the row

scope.included: up to 4 splits over unary rule-free predicates, at most 10 symbols, one context and one subject per row
scope.excluded: information-losing stages (projection), splits with rules, polyadic predicates, cross-context inference, persistence over time, bridging to base statuses

check_split_combination: one for each old valuation examined in lexicographic order of the sorted old symbols, per component, until the first counterexample, for the combination and for each split alone
query_split_combination: one per assertion and one per review before selecting each view in id order
one at each query start in id order within each view
one for each axiom-satisfying assignment of each component examined for the query
one before committing each computed row

enumeration: the axiom-satisfying assignments of a component are built when the request is validated and are not charged; they are finite because of the symbol limit
validation_order: JSON, request, consumer, budget, package, splits, query validation before any step
budget_stop: retain completed rows; unfinished rows are blocked with step_limit and carry no candidate set; an unfinished certificate is not issued
hashes: native spec raw SHA-256 pinned in handler; snapshot SHA-256 over canonical JSON, UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false
